claims.statement: The PPWR generally applies from 12 August 2026 and sets requirements for packaging placed on the EU market, creating current compliance work around packaging specifications and supplier evidence.
Packaging manufacturers and brands face specification and compliance costs; procurement, quality or packaging leadership is a plausible payer, but exact Polish budgets are unverified.

A customer can potentially appoint the business under an ordinary workflow-integration agreement to operate its evidence-request queue and retain authorized records, but no such agreement or evidence right is currently executed.
Buyer-side supplier-document activity and public paid PPWR service offers support testing a fixed-scope evidence-operations service, although they do not validate demand for this specific offer.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Packaging, quality or procurement director at a brand or manufacturer
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Resistance comes from operating the customer's approval queue, evidence request cadence and exception log under a service-level agreement, not from generic document storage; this is still reproducible by PLM vendors and consultants.
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own the direct brand contract and service relationship; each brand would retain its supplier relationships, source-document ownership and approval authority.
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Founder-controlled direct outbound to mid-market brands, followed only by nonexclusive paid referral agreements with consultants or laboratories if obtainable; no referral access is currently contracted.

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Unvalidated planning range: 4,000-12,000 PLN in founder time, prospecting, discovery and proposal work per won customer; stop the channel if paid-pilot gross profit does not recover CAC within 12 months.
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Require 50% of setup fees at signing, 50% at delivery, and managed-service retainers quarterly in advance; supplier chasing beyond the included allowance is prepaid to limit working-capital exposure.
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Unvalidated target: 45-65% on the managed service after delivery labor, specialist review and software costs, materially below the prior subscription assumption; calculate from time sheets and vendor invoices for every pilot.
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Planning case per initial portfolio: 40-100 hours for intake, evidence mapping and exception setup, then 8-20 hours monthly for supplier follow-up, updates and support; work beyond the contracted SKU, supplier and request limits is separately billed.
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Planning case: 6,000-15,000 PLN monthly once operating, covering independent regulatory counsel allocation, professional and cyber insurance, security tooling, accounting and privacy documentation; regulatory conclusions remain with qualified counsel or the customer.
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Fixed-fee onboarding for a defined packaging portfolio plus a quarterly prepaid managed evidence-operations retainer with explicit SKU, supplier-request and review allowances.
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Contract operations labor, independent packaging or regulatory review, OCR and storage, supplier communications and customer support; pass through extraordinary laboratory tests and translation with customer approval.

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: PLM vendors can bundle equivalent fields and portals, low-cost tools can undercut storage, and consultants can add document chasing. Defensibility therefore depends on faster implementation, accountable exception closure and exportable service records, without claiming proprietary-data exclusivity.
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: The brand pays at a signed, fixed-scope packaging evidence baseline and again for operating each quarterly evidence-request and exception queue; the measurable loss is staff time, delayed approval or rework caused by missing supplier documentation.
commercial_mechanics.payer: Brand owner, importer or packaging manufacturer
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: A dated PPWR documentation gap assessment, packaging approval backlog, supplier change or audit request with named missing evidence.
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Quarterly renewal only if the customer continues outsourcing evidence requests and exception closure; packaging or supplier revisions create separately measurable expansion events.

contrary_evidence: Low-price products already provide declarations, supplier tools, repositories and evidence trails, so software storage alone cannot sustain premium pricing.
An established specification-management vendor already bundles supplier collaboration, approvals and automated PPWR reporting.
Important requirements phase through 2030, so near-term urgency differs by portfolio.
No buyer, distribution agreement, rights agreement or fully loaded cohort economics for this redesigned service is currently validated.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Proposed, unsigned 12-month customer workflow-integration agreement and data-processing schedule appointing the business to run a defined evidence-request queue, receive customer-authorized supplier submissions, retain an audit log, and use only customer-specific records for service delivery; cross-customer benchmarking is excluded unless separately consented.
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Sell a prepaid, customer-upload-only evidence baseline and exception register with no supplier access, no ongoing integration and no benchmarking; if the customer will not provide the minimum documents or pay for the baseline, do not launch that account.
critical_control_point.current_owner: Each brand or manufacturer controls its packaging specifications, supplier mandates and approval workflow; suppliers and laboratories control their source evidence, and the prospective business currently owns none of those rights.
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own the direct brand contract and service relationship; each brand would retain its supplier relationships, source-document ownership and approval authority.
critical_control_point.duration: Proposed 12-month initial term; no duration is established until an agreement is executed.
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: No present access rights are established; access would arise account by account only from the proposed customer authorization and supplier submission terms, without using confidential employer resources.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: The founder controls direct sales, the independently built workflow software and service staffing; the first customer controls whether it signs, supplies documents and authorizes supplier routing.
critical_control_point.renewal: Proposed quarterly prepaid service schedule within the initial term and annual renewal thereafter; unsigned and unvalidated.
critical_control_point.subject: Customer-authorized packaging evidence request and exception workflow

economics.acquisition_route: Sell a prepaid 8,000-18,000 PLN customer-upload-only evidence baseline through founder-controlled direct outbound; offer the 12-month managed workflow only after documenting missing-evidence volume, delivery hours and a willing budget owner. Referrals are optional, not a launch dependency.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated planning case: reach 30 customers averaging 48,000 PLN annual managed-service revenue for 1.44M PLN revenue, then standardize delivery toward 55% contribution margin before fixed overhead. A later 100-customer operation at 60,000 PLN average revenue would produce 6M PLN revenue; 15-25% sustainable owner earnings and a 3-4x revenue value could make a retained majority stake exceed 5M PLN in roughly years 7-10. This path fails if CAC exceeds first-year gross profit, delivery remains founder-bound, or renewal is weak.
economics.founder_time: Cap founder work near 20-25 hours weekly: direct sales, workflow design and quality review; use independent contractors for bounded evidence operations and qualified counsel for regulatory interpretation.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Revenue less directly attributable operations labor, specialist review, OCR, storage, supplier communications and support; target 45-65% initially, measured per account rather than assumed from software margins.
economics.payback: Require the buyer to identify labor hours, approval delay or rework at baseline; proceed to the managed term only when conservative annual avoided cost exceeds the quoted first-year fee. Actual payback is unknown until paid pilots are delivered.
economics.pricing: 8,000-18,000 PLN prepaid evidence baseline; proposed 3,500-8,000 PLN monthly managed service billed quarterly in advance, with explicit portfolio limits and separately priced excess work.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Quarterly continuation depends on recurring supplier requests, document expiry, packaging changes and closed exceptions; renewal and expansion remain unvalidated and are tracked by queue volume, resolution time and retained accounts.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Reusable operating playbooks, exception taxonomies and measured resolution benchmarks derived only from records the business is contractually permitted to use; no present data moat is claimed.
fingerprint.customer: EU mid-market brands, importers and packaging manufacturers.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Founder-controlled direct outbound, with optional nonexclusive contracted referrals after launch rather than dependence on unsigned consultant, laboratory or converter introductions.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Prepaid packaging-evidence baseline followed by a productized managed evidence-request and exception-closure service under a customer workflow-integration agreement.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Brand pays for a fixed-scope evidence baseline and quarterly operation of its supplier-document exception queue.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A dated documentation gap, approval backlog, supplier change or audit request with identifiable missing evidence.

founder_fit: FMCG domain familiarity can inform public-market workflow hypotheses while strict separation from Reckitt systems, documents, contacts and confidential knowledge remains mandatory.
Data modeling and document automation fit the evidence register and exception workflow.
Direct outbound and productized delivery can be scheduled part-time and do not require a public-facing personal brand.
The 55,000 PLN planning budget remains below available founder capital and uses prepaid pilots before substantial scaling.

redesign.economic_effect: The redesign abandons high-margin vault economics and unsigned referral/supplier dependence for a direct-sold, prepaid productized service. A proposed customer workflow agreement makes access contractible account by account and customer procurement authority routes supplier requests, while the upload-only baseline is the refusal fallback. This lowers required capital and working-capital exposure but adds substantial delivery labor, reduces the plausible contribution margin to 45-65%, and makes CAC recovery, capacity and renewal explicit validation gates.

risks: No workflow-integration, data-processing, customer, supplier or referral agreement is currently executed.
Customers may refuse to route supplier communications or provide sufficient source records, leaving only the lower-value baseline.
Managed delivery may remain labor-intensive, suppress contribution margin and conflict with the founder's part-time capacity.
PLM vendors, low-price tools and consultants can reproduce or bundle the workflow.
Regulatory interpretation, confidentiality, data protection, cybersecurity and professional-liability exposure require independent counsel and insurance.
Strict separation from all Reckitt confidential resources, systems, documents and relationships is mandatory.

structural_signature.commercial_model_descriptor: prepaid packaging evidence baseline plus bounded managed exception operations
structural_signature.control_point_descriptor: proposed customer authorized evidence request and exception queue
structural_signature.critical_dependency_descriptor: customer execution of the workflow agreement and routing of procurement authority

structure.control_point: Customer-authorized evidence request queue and exception log embedded in packaging approval
structure.critical_dependency: A customer must sign the workflow agreement, provide source records and route supplier requests; supplier referrals and a proprietary shared dataset are not required for launch.

thesis: Operate a brand's bounded packaging-evidence request and exception queue under a customer authorization, beginning with a prepaid customer-upload-only baseline and expanding only when paid delivery proves recurring work and viable account economics.
title: PPWR Evidence Operations Desk
uncertainties: Whether target buyers will purchase the prepaid baseline or managed term at the proposed prices
Whether customers will execute the workflow and data-processing terms and route supplier requests
Actual direct-outbound CAC, sales cycle and baseline-to-managed conversion
Delivery hours, specialist-review cost, support burden and contribution margin by portfolio size
Quarterly retention and expansion after initial documentation gaps are closed
Whether authorized aggregate benchmarks can ever be developed without compromising confidentiality
Which portfolio obligations create enough near-term urgency before later PPWR phases
